title: Snapshot equality and stale threshold
failure_mode: Strict future comparison versus inclusive age comparison

findings.statement: The snapshot > now check permits equality with now; with no invalid snapshots, stale begins when age_days is at least max_age_days.
findings.rationale: The future comparison is strict while the stale comparison is inclusive.

findings.statement: A snapshot exactly equal to now is rejected as a future timestamp.
